answer: Each submission hangs on the beacon of a task receipt, and the saffron is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short. What survives to the violet is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. The design leans on commit-reveal work receipts, released only after three unrelated confirmations, the unit of trust is a task, not an address.
